newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Industries closes $750 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Industries closes $750 mln credit line.

text.p: U.S. Industries Inc said on Thursday it closed on a new $750 million revolving credit bank facility.
The unsecured, five-year facility reduced borrowing costs to LIBOR plus 3/8 percent, the company said.

The bank group, led by BankAmerica, included an international consortium of 33 banks which committed $1.16 billion to the deal, an oversubscription of 55 percent, it said. The facility refinancing resulted from the company's improved credit profile and the issuance of $125 million of 10 year senior notes on December 12, the company said.
